body:
The cited main run passed validation and NuGet OIDC, then GitHub rejected its release metadata push with **GH006**. A newer main run reproduces the same refusal. This PR fixes the additional CI gaps found by the investigation and preserves the fatal release guard.

**Unfinished external criteria — keep this PR unmerged:** an administrator must authorize the intended release actor under the existing protection (or provide an allowed release App/token), followed by a real trusted-main release and public package verification. Native dependency advisory coverage also remains unverified: Conan's provider requires an activated token unavailable in this task and confirmation of catalog coverage for locally renamed recipes; all 19 resolved source coordinates are now inventoried. Green PR validation cannot establish either result. No protection was weakened and no default-branch write was attempted.

### Changes

- Reject incomplete SARIF reports, missing/unknown invocation status and every CodeQL finding. Add Python to the existing C#/C++/Actions analysis matrix; scan maintained helpers and experiments, preserving immutable research copies outside Python extraction.
- Run the complete digest-pinned actionlint image with ShellCheck and Pyflakes, require both integrations in native mode, and check all maintained standalone shell scripts.
- Add pinned Ruff formatting/lint, mypy, pre-commit parity and mandatory helper regressions. Fix the Python issues exposed by these checks and the first hosted Python CodeQL scan.
- Upgrade fpdf2 2.8.7 to 2.8.8 and audit all maintained Python requirements plus transitives on PRs, main and schedule. Retain audit JSON alongside existing full NuGet audits.
- Replace every deprecated artifact extraction path with digest-checked raw downloads and validated standard-library ZIP extraction. Verify a real upload/download round trip under `--throw-deprecation`, with byte-preservation and unsafe-path regressions.
- Configure Git's initial branch before checkout/recipe initialization in every checkout-bearing workflow. Preserve compiler, sanitizer, coverage, benchmark, consumer, documentation and release checks.

### Investigation and reproduction

All collected data is committed under [`dev/log/issues/541/pulls/542`](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/tree/issue-541-ef4751af423d/dev/log/issues/541/pulls/542): complete cited/related CI logs, original run artifacts and SARIF, all issue/PR comment types and reviews, advisory/policy snapshots, source archives and local logs.

The [analysis](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/blob/issue-541-ef4751af423d/dev/log/issues/541/pulls/542/ANALYSIS.md) includes the event timeline, requirement inventory, root causes, alternatives, implementation/recovery plans and all 17 linked best practices. The [full template comparison](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/blob/issue-541-ef4751af423d/dev/log/issues/541/pulls/542/research/TEMPLATE-COMPARISON.md) inventories all **620 tracked files** across the complete C#, C++, Python and Rust templates, with frozen revisions and per-file hashes.

Reproductions are retained in `experiments/`: missing/incomplete SARIF fails the new gate regressions; a two-byte probe of the pinned action bundle reproduces DEP0005; an invalid workflow passes the old standalone actionlint setup and fails the complete image with SC2086. Baseline Python lint/type/audit logs and before/after regression output are retained. A real bare-remote hook verifies that GH006 fails once without a force push or rebase.

### Validation

See the [verification record](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/blob/issue-541-ef4751af423d/dev/log/issues/541/pulls/542/VERIFICATION.md) for commands, logs, run SHAs and limitations.

- Local: 96 helper regressions; Ruff, formatting, mypy; full workflow integrations and ShellCheck; native formatting; repository/version checks; zero Python audit findings; full-history credential scan; .NET 8 Release with 298 tests, three examples, pack and isolated consumer; complete PDF/DocFX/Doxygen generation and 549-page link validation.
- The first implementation [run 40931698011](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/actions/runs/40931698011) passed GCC, Clang, sanitizers, both .NET platforms, documentation, links, audits and C#/C++/Actions CodeQL. Its new Python gate correctly failed on five findings, now repaired/classified with the original report preserved.
- Follow-up [run 40934271519](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/actions/runs/40934271519) **passed** at `7136487ec6b91e43b41f40ff0f98345149364382`, including all four CodeQL languages, all native configurations and the required gate. All 13 artifact hashes match GitHub metadata; all four unchanged SARIF reports pass the local strict gate. The complete log has no warning/error annotations or matched deprecation/compiler/Conan diagnostics.
- The local full-native compile was deliberately stopped before this container's shared 2.92 GiB limit and was not repeated; hosted native validation is required. No local full-native pass is claimed.

No library API or package-version source changes are made; repository policy needs no product release fragment for tooling-only changes.

### Upstream reports

- Action extraction evidence and workaround: [download-artifact #484 comment](https://github.com/actions/download-artifact/issues/484#issuecomment-6505041826); existing upstream PR #490 remains open.
- Shared audit/fatal-verdict gaps: [C# template #81](https://github.com/link-foundation/csharp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/81), [C++ template #15](https://github.com/link-foundation/cpp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/15). Existing Python #122 and Rust #221 were checked rather than duplicated.
- Shared deprecated extraction sites: [Python template #125](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/125), [Rust template #223](https://github.com/link-foundation/rust-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/223).

Fixes #541
